column1: # The Z9X recipe (horse_popular, G0082): the published image's signed tar patched with what changed (tools/patch_tar.py),
# then erofs from the tar (--tar=f), as the release kits since 1.0.4 (~/lumen-build-tmp/rNNN). Steps of
# tools/build/engine.py, WHEN<TAB>OP<TAB>ARGS, run on the Mac (Z9X artifacts stay there); the erofs step runs in a
# container with the LineageOS host tools (pack_runner). stage/ is the Mac signing step's output: apk/ (re-signed with
# the release keys), dex/ (odex and vdex against the base's boot image), props/ (the two build.prop files of
# devices/horse_popular/image/z9x_props.py). No test adb of any kind goes into this image. check_image.py and
# lumen_checks.py run from the repository ({REPO}: they read tools/sign, tools/lumen, tools/ota/image, overlay/v1).
# the projector app, the updater and AirPlay (system/app) and the three priv-apps with their odex and vdex
# the HDMI input app (org.lumen.tvinput: the TV input service, the HDMI viewer, HDMI-CEC; apps/LumenTvInput) over the
# 1.0.9 copy at the same path, with its odex and vdex: the Source key card reads its viewer's manifest mark
# the first-run app (Lumen Setup, apps/LumenSetup through devices/horse_popular/app/Z9xSetup.layers) over the 1.0.9
# copy at the same path, with its odex and vdex
# the on-screen keyboard of every model: Lumen Keyboard (apps/LumenKeyboard, the LeanbackIME package with keyboard
# languages and a language key) in LeanbackIME's place; its odex and vdex against the base's boot image
# Add accessory says Paired for a speaker that connects before the screen listens, About shows the projector's model
# code, XGIMI firmware and Back to the XGIMI system: the base TvSettings with the fixes of tools/base_patch (the
# Android 15 BluetoothA2dpConnector, the About rows), swapped in on the Mac and signed with the release platform key;
# its base odex and vdex are for the old dex, ART would refuse them, so they go and ART compiles the app itself
# screen mirroring: the Wi-Fi Direct device type "television" for Windows (apps/LumenWifiP2pOverlay, static RRO, no dex)
# the framework keys overlay and the remote key layouts: the gear held on the XGIMI remotes opens the game menu
# the native UI fifo stub (its model list: the mask is drawn by the Projector app only on these models)
# install from the projector, screen mirroring permissions, the sysconfig, the Google add-on reader
# the HDMI receiver bridge of the signal panel (apps/core/lumen-signal/image, devices/horse_popular/signal.tsv
# hdmi_format): a root oneshot that asks the MStar receiver for its info dump and leaves the info lines for the app
# the one blobs reader of every model (tools/ota/image) over the 1.0.9 copy, with the Z9X's settings: the installed
# path as before (tools/devices/test/blobs_parity.py), and in a trial run the codec and audio files read-only from the
# stock slot (sound and secure video in a trial); ro.lumen.models (z9x_props.py) names the model it does that on
# the first boot over stock data without a language and time zone of its own (block 3 empties the stock wizard's)
# the stock volume split (lumen-audio StockVolume): the tree's z9x_base.rc turns AVRCP absolute volume off at
# early-boot as the stock vendor build.prop, and the 1.0.9 click curve copy goes (Android plays clicks at 0 dB, the DSP
# applies the volume)
# the stock model properties a Lumen Z9X reads (z9x_model_props.rc: the XGIMI init loads
# vendor/etc/xgimimodelname/G0082/build.prop, LineageOS init does not; the trapezoid lines stay in z9x_trapezoid.rc),
# one block per vendor firmware, the prop file proven against each pinned stock file first
# the Google sign-in helper (lineage/gmsprops, devices/_image/gmsprops, as on the HB): the arm64 library and init helper,
# the 32-bit library for the 32-bit zygote, its rc and data file. It acts only while Google services are there
# (sys.z9x.gapps), persist.sys.lumen.gms_compat=0 turns it off. Binaries built on the builder (lineage/gmsprops/build.sh),
# staged by the release kit into stage/gms, pinned here
# the two build.prop files (z9x_props.py on the Mac; the product one ends with devices/_image/first_start_prop.txt)
# the one first-start setting of every image decides the language and time zone with any vendor
# erofs (4 KiB blocks, lz4hc, no inline data, the fixed 2009 time), fsck, extract, every changed member read back
